title.narrative: Malthe Winje AS Development of small hydro power plants in Ukraine

description.narrative:
The project’s expected effects on society (impact) are to increase the generation of and access to stable, renewable power in Ukraine. The aim is to facilitate the development of specific small-scale hydropower plants to lay the groundwork for further hydropower projects across the country. For the target groups, the project is expected to improve access to reliable electricity for the local population and to enhance the operating environment for developers of small hydropower projects more broadly.
The planned main outcome in this phase is to document the feasibility of small-scale hydropower plants and to identify the key barriers to wider adoption of such solutions in Ukraine. This will provide valuable insights to inform future regulatory and policy decisions.
The intended target groups are the population in Ukraine—as well as stakeholders in the distributed renewable energy sector, including developers, investors, regulators, and policy makers.
The project aims to increase the generation of and access to stable, renewable energy in Ukraine by supporting the development of small-scale hydropower plants. By laying the groundwork for additional hydropower projects, the initiative is expected to have a positive impact on society—specifically by improving access to reliable electricity for local populations and enhancing the operating environment for developers, investors, and other stakeholders in the renewable energy sector.
The primary outcome in this phase is to document the feasibility of small-scale hydropower plants and identify the main barriers to broader adoption of such solutions in Ukraine. These findings will provide important insights for future regulatory and policy decisions.
